Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck
pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical strain, or whiplash. The
mechanism of injury described is a plausible cause of these symptoms. Over the course
of care the patient attended a total of 30 visits, which is somewhat longer than
typically expected for this type of injury. Physical examination revealed reduced
cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness that support the reported
injury, while certain neurological screening tests and imaging-related assessments
returned normal results. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving
the cervical spine. Billing records were reviewed and show no duplicate or repeated
charges for the same services. Ongoing management includes home exercise instruction,
periodic reassessment, and a plan to taper care as symptoms allow.
